steps: Open toki://timer/start?task=Physics; while a timer runs, try selecting another task
expected: An idle linked session uses the matching active task; a running or paused session retains its original task
actual: Missing/invalid/ambiguous links formerly lacked resolution; planner rows formerly changed selectedTaskId before the deep link rejected the start
root_cause: Legacy titles are accepted only when unique; selection also occurred before start acceptance and could reassign an active session
impact: External sessions could be unattributed and an active session could be credited to the wrong task
fix_proposal: Resolve the ID or unique legacy title and assign it only for an accepted idle start; preserve selection while the timer is active
test_case: TaskLinkResolverTest: ID lookup, unique legacy title, ambiguous/missing/invalid/completed links; TaskSelectionPolicyTest: active retention and idle selection/clear
evidence: TaskLinkResolver.kt and TaskSelectionPolicy.kt; planner no longer mutates task selection before dispatch; targeted regression tests passed; device flow not exercised

steps: Open toki://timer/start?duration=-1 and a very large positive Int
expected: Invalid values are rejected or mapped to a safe supported duration
actual: Any Int parses; custom value is multiplied by 60 without range validation
root_cause: No input range validation before timer/alarm/service creation
impact: Malformed external link can create nonsensical/overflowed timer and delay values; exact runtime outcome unverified
fix_proposal: Validate and clamp/reject duration before updating state or scheduling service/alarm
test_case: DeepLinkDurationTest: omitted default, supported boundaries, malformed and out-of-range values
evidence: DeepLinkDuration.kt:4-15; targeted and full testDebugUnitTest passed (10 tests); Android deep-link runtime not exercised

steps: Inspect current app shell; if TasksScreen is launched, change calendar date
expected: Planner can be opened and selected date changes displayed task list
actual: No app-shell caller for TasksScreen; its Flow is initialized from the first selected date and is not switched on later changes
root_cause: Screen is not wired into app navigation; query Flow is selected only when ViewModel is constructed
impact: Calendar/planner functions are inaccessible; if wired as-is, changing date may keep old query
fix_proposal: Decide whether planner should be exposed; if so add route and derive query with flatMapLatest keyed by selectedDate
test_case: SelectedDateTaskFlowTest: one active collector receives the query result for each selected date; planner shell route reviewed statically
status: FIXED; unit-tested; QA-17 planner entry, task submission and scrolling passed on RMX2156; selected-date switching not independently device-verified
evidence: selectedDateTaskFlow uses flatMapLatest; selected-date test passed; Manage tasks shell route and Back/tab handling compile in assembleDebug; app/build/device-qa/planner-font-135.png; app/build/device-qa/task-created-135.xml

steps: On RMX2156, inspect Home and Settings at font scales 0.9, 1.35 and 1.6; inspect the TalkBack tree.
expected: Bottom navigation is fully above the system navigation area, with visible labels and nonzero accessibility bounds.
actual: At 0.9, tab labels overlap the system navigation area; at 1.6 they clip. TalkBack tree reports all three tab labels at [0,0] bounds.
root_cause: The custom bottom bar applies fixed padding but no visible navigation-bar inset in the tested layout; larger font scales further exceed available height.
impact: Tab labels and hit targets are difficult to see or reach, especially at large text sizes; accessibility traversal has zero-size tab nodes.
fix_proposal: Apply the app window inset policy to the bottom bar and validate at 360 dp with large fonts; keep each tab node within visible, nonzero bounds.
evidence: app/build/device-qa/home-font-135.png; app/build/device-qa/home-font-160-clear.png; app/build/device-qa/settings-font-160.png; app/build/device-qa/talkback-home-live.png; app/build/device-qa/talkback-home-retry.xml; typography idle/live and latest Home pass at 0.9 (`typography-home-final.png`); large-scale retest NOT_TESTED (Realme font picker could not be changed)

steps: Start an offline focus timer, force-stop com.focusfirst, then relaunch it.
expected: The active session restores from its saved end time or reports a consistent interruption state.
actual: Relaunch displayed idle 25:00, even though persisted preferences still had timer_was_running=true and a future timer_end_time_ms.
root_cause: The service persists timer state and BootReceiver handles reboot recovery, but ordinary app process recreation did not restore the persisted running session in this test.
impact: A force-stop or process loss makes an active focus session appear reset and loses the current timer state.
fix_proposal: Read and reconcile persisted timer state on app/service startup; add a process-recreation regression test that verifies remaining time against the saved end timestamp.

steps: Install the Toki widget, run a timer, stop/restart the app, compare widget time with Home.
expected: Widget time and phase match the current timer state after app restart and stop.
actual: Widget retained 09:10 while Toki displayed idle 25:00.
root_cause: Widget state is held in separate Glance preferences and was not synchronized to Home timer state on the tested restart/idle path; exact missing update trigger needs follow-up.
impact: Widget can show stale focus state and mislead the user after restarting Toki.
fix_proposal: Update or clear widget state on every timer state transition and reconcile it when the app or service restarts.

steps: Enable TalkBack and inspect the Home UI tree.
expected: Start is exposed as an actionable control, and navigation tabs have visible bounds and labels.
actual: Start was present as text but not a clickable accessibility node; tab labels had zero bounds. Timer status itself had the label Focus ready, 25 minutes remaining.
root_cause: The primary action and bottom navigation semantics were not exposed as actionable, visible nodes in the device accessibility hierarchy.
impact: Screen-reader users may not be able to start a focus session or navigate reliably.
fix_proposal: Expose the primary action and tab semantics as accessible actions and verify the TalkBack hierarchy and spoken order on device.

steps: Open Settings and activate Light mode.
expected: Light mode selection switches the app palette and persisted preference.
actual: The row is a noninteractive static placeholder stating the toggle ships in a later polish pass; Toki stays dark.
root_cause: Light mode interaction has not been implemented.
impact: Users cannot switch to the advertised light appearance.
fix_proposal: Implement and persist a light/dark mode selection or remove the unavailable control until supported.

steps: Start a focus session, wait briefly, stop it, and inspect idle feedback.
expected: Home returns to a clear ready state without suggesting elapsed minutes remain.
actual: Home showed 00:00 and Focus ready, 0 minutes remaining after stopping a partial session.
root_cause: The stopped timer resets remaining time to zero and the idle accessibility summary formats zero as remaining time.
impact: The timer feedback is confusing immediately after a partial session is stopped.
fix_proposal: Use an idle-ready summary for stopped timers and keep elapsed session duration separate from remaining time.
